Synth Pins In Real

'Plan in sim, fly in real through the pin', visualized: at anchors on the real flights (grey), the same real observation is served with three different commands. The blue fans are sim-authored routes executing on real perception — task-valid at the right gate. Right scene first (the cell in question); toggle groups to compare.

RIGHT

drag to orbit · wheel to zoom · shift-drag to pan

Same real anchors, three commands. Blue = the matched SIM state's oracle pin served on the real observation: it flies the planner's route — visibly different line than the grey pilot flights, but full speed and 11/11 in-aperture at the right gate (s=0.32 vs pilots' 0.45). Amber = the head's own command (under-sped 0.60 m chunks, the scatter Denis flagged). Green = real oracle command (4 deg residual — the execution ceiling).
